en.headline: AFCD to prosecute three owners for failing to leash large dogs
en.dek: During Sunday patrols in Yuen Long, West Kowloon, Cyberport and Kai Tak, officers found three people suspected of not properly controlling large dogs in public; further checks continue next weekend.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said it would prosecute three dog owners after special control patrols on Sunday found them suspected of failing to keep large dogs on a lead in public places.

Officers visited areas including Yuen Long, the West Kowloon waterfront, Cyberport and Kai Tak. The department said the three cases involved large dogs, defined as those weighing 20 kilograms or more, that were not secured by a lead of two metres or less as required under the Dangerous Dogs Regulation.

Staff also distributed leaflets reminding owners that dogs must be properly controlled in public under the Rabies Ordinance, and that large dogs must be kept on a short lead. The special operations will continue on 5 and 6 September at locations where dogs gather.

zh.headline: 漁護署巡查將檢控三狗主 涉公眾地方未用狗帶牽引大狗
zh.dek: 周日在元朗、西九、數碼港及啟德一帶巡查，發現三名畜養人涉嫌未妥善控制大型狗隻，署方將提出檢控，下周末行動繼續。
body: 漁農自然護理署表示，周日展開妥善控制狗隻特別巡查及執法行動後，發現三名畜養人涉嫌在公眾地方未有以狗帶牽引大型狗隻，將就相關個案提出檢控。
署方人員分別到元朗、西九龍海濱、數碼港及啟德一帶巡查，並向市民派發單張。根據《危險狗隻規例》，體重達20公斤或以上的大型狗隻在公眾地方必須以長度不超逾兩米的狗帶穩妥牽引。
漁護署提醒，根據《狂犬病條例》，狗隻在公眾地方時必須以狗帶牽引或以其他有效方式控制。特別巡查及執法行動將於9月5日及6日繼續在全港多個狗隻聚集地點進行。
